newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand expects another major auto investment.
newsitem.headline: Thailand expects another major auto investment.

text.p: Another major automobile manufacturer is expected to set up its Asian production facility in Thailand soon, the head of the Board of Investment (BOI) said on Thursday.
But Staporn Kavitanon, BOI secretary general, declined to give details of the potential investor.
"I promised to keep the details confidential. And I would prefer the company to make an announcement itself," he told reporters.
Thailand has become the automobile industry's regional hub with investments for regional plant establishments from such big names as General Motors Corp, Ford Motor Co and Honda Motor Co Ltd.
Chrysler Corp earlier this year said it was looking into the possibility of locating a new vehicle assembly plant in Thailand or Indonesia.
More investments in electronics and computer peripherals chip manufacturing were also likely in Thailand in the near future, said Staporn.
One business group expressed interest investing in electronic parts here, he said.
Although he did not name the company, there have been rumours that Thailand's giant conglomerate Chareon Phokpand is interested in such project.
Staporn said despite a slowdown in the Thai economy, he still expected strong investment in the field of parts and components, electric products and electronics.
